description: Upload in PC mode, then PC exit: PB1 high enters PC mode (:w11=0,0, to both); the PC unlock state is set; :g09/:p09/:n09 upload a 2-step program to slot 9 over U1 (:ok, SPI-flash erase/program); PB1 low: :w15=0,0, to both, then the runner sends G1 the idle configuration of step 1 of the uploaded program (the upload filled G1's program buffer and forced a resend); HOME; read-back of slot 9
note: The original accepts uploads in PC mode only after the vendor unlock handshake (out of scope); the pc_unlock event sets the resulting ui_flags bit instead. The original drew the PC icon red at PC entry and does not redraw it, so the icon is masked.
